title: Who was in McKinney's band when he joined
summary: He lists the trumpets, saxophones and rhythm section, and Billy Taylor replacing Escudero on bass.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Who were all the guys in that band -- this, again, I'm trying to recapture this band of McKinney's -- when you joined it?

When I joined the band the trumpets were Langston Curl -- he was playing first trumpet. Joe Smith was out but he came back -- and Buddy Lee, George Oliver Buddy Lee. And, by the way, he's Jonah Jones' cousin.
Uh-huh. And the saxophones was Edward Inge and Jimmy Dudley and Prince Robinson. Jim Larson was the drummer and Dave Wilburn was the guitar player and Escudero was the bass player.
Now, Escudero left, oh, not long -- I hadn't been in the band too long and Don sent to New York and got Billy Taylor to come in Escudero's place.
That was a fantastic bass player, Milt.
